name: Celestial Palatinate
description: The titanic power behind the Free Company, rival to the Monasteriat.

description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Palatinate sends Sunstar Free Company knights to stop the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin at Sothera.
timeline.quote: the Palatinate has dispatched a force of Sunstar Free Company knights to drive the Monoists out and deploy one of their javelins

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen sees that her fellow passengers are three Sunstar Free Company men-at-arms.
timeline.quote: There are three of them: three men-at-arms belonging to the Sunstar Free Company, pride and blade of the Celestial Palatinate.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: In memory, Reen recalls Joska and the Palatinate lander that her squad targeted.
timeline.quote: If she keeps her eyes shut, she sees, inevitably, the target: a Palatinate lander bobbing just offshore.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen suspects a Palatinate hack and agrees to inspect the memory cores.
timeline.quote: If the Palatinate really is using the Wurmwall as a staging ground and seeks to conceal its activities …

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen realizes the ancient alien presence might make the Palatinate's horizon javelin look trivial.
timeline.quote: She realizes she's stumbled onto something that, if weaponized, might make the Palatinate's horizon javelin look trivial by comparison.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.
